boarding_points.name: São Sebastião Ferry Terminal (Balsa)
boarding_points.operator: Semil-SP / DH — passing to Acqua Vias SP concession (Nov 2025 PPP)
boarding_points.notes: Mainland head of the only 24h link to Ilhabela; ~12,584 users/day (Jan 2024). Adjacent to São Sebastião historic centre and commercial port.
boarding_points.source: OpenStreetMap ferry_terminal node; Semil-SP travessia pages

boarding_points.name: Ilhabela Ferry Terminal (Barra Velha)
boarding_points.operator: Semil-SP / DH — passing to Acqua Vias SP concession (Nov 2025 PPP)
boarding_points.notes: Island head of the balsa crossing; also an Aquabus stop (Píer da Balsa – Barra Velha).
boarding_points.source: OpenStreetMap ferry_terminal node 'Ilhabela'; Prefeitura de Ilhabela Aquabus page

boarding_points.name: Píer da Vila (Historic Centre / cruise tender berth)
boarding_points.operator: Prefeitura de Ilhabela (Aquabus stop); cruise tenders in season
boarding_points.notes: Heart of Ilhabela's historic village; Aquabus northern terminus and cruise-ship tender landing.
boarding_points.source: OpenStreetMap 'Cruise Ship Tender Berth'; Prefeitura de Ilhabela Aquabus page

boarding_points.name: Píer do Perequê (Aquabus)
boarding_points.notes: Municipal water-bus pier on Av. Princesa Isabel, Perequê — closest island pier to the ferry corridor.
boarding_points.source: OpenStreetMap pier node 'Aquabus'; Prefeitura de Ilhabela Aquabus page

boarding_points.name: Píer do Engenho D'Água (Aquabus)
boarding_points.notes: Official Aquabus stop between Perequê and Vila (ticket point at Av. Pedro Paula de Moraes 1146). Pier coordinate not verifiable from official/OSM sources — left null pending survey.
boarding_points.source: Prefeitura de Ilhabela Aquabus page (stop list)

boarding_points.name: Píer da Praia Grande (Aquabus)
boarding_points.notes: Aquabus southern terminus. Coordinate is locale-level (OSM Praia Grande beach node); exact pier position on the beach frontage to be confirmed at survey.
boarding_points.source: Prefeitura de Ilhabela Aquabus page; OSM/Nominatim Praia Grande beach node (locale-level)

boarding_points.name: Yacht Club de Ilhabela (YCI)
boarding_points.notes: Host club of Ilhabela Sailing Week (SIVI), Latin America's biggest sailing event; sits on the Saco da Capela cove between Vila and Perequê, with a sub-station at Saco do Sombrio. Pier coordinate not verifiable from official/OSM sources — left null pending survey.
boarding_points.source: SIVI / press references to YCI at Saco da Capela

boarding_points.name: Marina Pinda (Saco da Capela)
boarding_points.notes: Verified marina point anchoring the Saco da Capela yacht cluster (adjacent to YCI).

boarding_points.name: Marina Porto Ilhabela
boarding_points.notes: Full-service marina on the island's west shore — natural charging and charter base on the channel.
boarding_points.source: OpenStreetMap marina node; Nominatim 'Marina Porto, Avenida Bandeirantes, Itaquanda, Pereque, Ilhabela'

boarding_points.name: Píer / Marina Igararecê (São Francisco)
boarding_points.linked_locale: São Francisco da Praia, São Sebastião (north shore)
boarding_points.notes: Mainland marina and pier north of the ferry head, facing Vila across the channel — northern diagonal of the channel mesh.

boarding_points.name: Praia de Castelhanos (beach landing)
boarding_points.notes: Boat-only flagship beach on the exposed Atlantic side; served today by speedboat tours (R$290–310/pax) and 4x4 track. No pier — beach/anchor landing, weather-window operations only; navigability on S/SE swell days must be validated in ops planning.
boarding_points.source: Nominatim/OSM beach node; Maremar & Bem Passeios tour pages

boarding_points.name: Praia do Bonete (beach landing)
boarding_points.notes: Celebrated caiçara-village beach on the island's south coast, reached today by boat tour or a long trail. No pier — exposed to southerly swell; weather-window spur only, navigability to be validated.
boarding_points.source: Nominatim/OSM beach node; Bem Passeios tarifário (Bonete flex-boat tour)
